0001: import json, os, re, sys, pathlib, datetime

0003: def safe_name(s: str) -> str:
0004:     s = (s or "").strip()
0005:     s = re.sub(r"[\\/:*?\"<>|]+", "-", s)
0006:     s = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", s)
0007:     s = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+", "-", s)
0008:     s = re.sub(r"-+", "-", s).strip("-._")
0009:     return s[:140] if s else "chat"
0010: 
0011: def extract_messages(obj):
0012:     # Best-effort across variants: {role, content} or nested shapes.
0013:     msgs = []
0014:     if isinstance(obj, dict):
0015:         role = obj.get("role") or obj.get("author") or obj.get("speaker") or obj.get("type")
0016:         content = obj.get("content")
0017: 
0018:         # Sometimes content is list of parts
0019:         if isinstance(content, list):
0020:             parts = []
0021:             for p in content:
0022:                 if isinstance(p, str):
0023:                     parts.append(p)
0024:                 elif isinstance(p, dict):
0025:                     parts.append(str(p.get("text") or p.get("value") or p.get("content") or ""))
0026:             content = "\n".join([x for x in parts if x])
0027: 
0028:         # Sometimes nested message
0029:         if content is None and "message" in obj and isinstance(obj["message"], dict):
0030:             m = obj["message"]
0031:             role = role or m.get("role")
0032:             content = m.get("content") or m.get("text")
0033: 
0034:         # Sometimes OpenAI-ish "output_text"/"input_text"
0035:         if content is None:
0036:             content = obj.get("text") or obj.get("output_text") or obj.get("input_text")
0037: 
0038:         if role in ("user","assistant","system") and isinstance(content, str) and content.strip():
0039:             msgs.append({"role": role, "content": content.strip()})
0040:             return msgs
0041: 
0042:         # Tool call outputs sometimes contain useful text
0043:         for k in ("tool_output","result","output","data"):
0044:             v = obj.get(k)
0045:             if isinstance(v, str) and v.strip():
0046:                 msgs.append({"role":"tool", "content": v.strip()})
0047:                 return msgs
0048: 
0049:     return msgs
0050: 
0051: def parse_jsonl(path):
0052:     records = []
0053:     with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
0054:         for line in f:
0055:             line = line.strip()
0056:             if not line:
0057:                 continue
0058:             try:
0059:                 obj = json.loads(line)
0060:             except Exception:
0061:                 continue
0062:             records.append(obj)
0063:     return records
0064: 
0065: def pick_title(messages, fallback):
0066:     for m in messages:
0067:         if m["role"] == "user" and len(m["content"]) > 6:
0068:             first = m["content"].splitlines()[0][:120]
0069:             return safe_name(first)
0070:     return safe_name(fallback)
0071: 
0072: def to_md(messages, header):
0073:     out = []
0074:     out.append(f"# {header}")
0075:     out.append("")
0076:     for m in messages:
0077:         role = m["role"]
0078:         if role == "assistant":
0079:             out.append("## Assistant")
0080:         elif role == "user":
0081:             out.append("## User")
0082:         elif role == "system":
0083:             out.append("## System")
0084:         else:
0085:             out.append("## Tool")
0086:         out.append("")
0087:         out.append(m["content"])
0088:         out.append("")
0089:     return "\n".join(out).rstrip() + "\n"

0099:     js_dir = out_dir / "json"

0101:     js_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

0103:     index = []
